# Security Policy

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability or include unpatched
exploit details in a public pull request or discussion.

Use **Security → Report a vulnerability** in this repository. That creates a
private report visible only to the reporter and repository maintainers.
Maintainers and repository agents should keep findings in their private working
conversation until a draft security advisory or another private remediation
channel has been explicitly selected.

Public disclosure happens only after remediation and deployment, at a level of
detail deliberately chosen by the maintainers.
